import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load data with proper headers
field_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
salary_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Normalize lookup
lookup_df['norm_code'] = lookup_df['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# Ensure district column is string
lookup_df['District'] = lookup_df['District'].astype(str)

# Build mapping norm_code -> district
code_to_district = dict(zip(lookup_df['norm_code'], lookup_df['District']))

# Field expenses processing
# Filter transaction ID starts with FE-
field_df['Transaction ID'] = field_df['Transaction ID'].astype(str)
field_mask = field_df['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-')
# Normalize cost centre
field_df['norm_cost'] = field_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
# Posting status normalized
field_df['norm_status'] = field_df['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field_mask &= field_df['norm_status'] == 'posted'
# Map district
field_df['district'] = field_df['norm_cost'].map(code_to_district)
# Exclude unmapped
field_df = field_df[field_df['district'].notna() & field_mask]
# Sum amounts
field_summary = field_df.groupby('district')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()

# Salary processing
salary_df['Payroll Line ID'] = salary_df['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str)
salary_mask = salary_df['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-')
salary_df['norm_cost'] = salary_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary_df['norm_status'] = salary_df['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary_mask &= salary_df['norm_status'] == 'paid'
salary_df['district'] = salary_df['norm_cost'].map(code_to_district)
salary_df = salary_df[salary_df['district'].notna() & salary_mask]
salary_summary = salary_df.groupby('district')['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum().reset_index()

print('Field summary')
print(field_summary.head(20))
print('Salary summary')
print(salary_summary.head(20))

# Combine
combined = pd.merge(field_summary, salary_summary, on='district', how='outer', suffixes=('_field','_salary'))
combined['Amount (INR)'] = combined['Amount (INR)'].fillna(0)
combined['Gross Salary (INR)'] = combined['Gross Salary (INR)'].fillna(0)
combined['total'] = combined['Amount (INR)'] + combined['Gross Salary (INR)']
combined = combined.sort_values('total', ascending=False)
print(combined.head(20))
print('Number of districts:', combined.shape[0])

import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

field_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
salary_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Clean lookup
lookup_df['norm_code'] = lookup_df['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
lookup_df['District'] = lookup_df['District'].astype(str).str.strip()
code_to_district = dict(zip(lookup_df['norm_code'], lookup_df['District']))

# Field
field_df['Transaction ID'] = field_df['Transaction ID'].astype(str)
field_df = field_df[field_df['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-')]
field_df['norm_cost'] = field_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field_df['norm_status'] = field_df['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field_df = field_df[field_df['norm_status']=='posted']
field_df['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(field_df['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
field_df['district'] = field_df['norm_cost'].map(code_to_district)
field_df = field_df[field_df['district'].notna()]
field_summary = field_df.groupby('district')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()

# Salary
salary_df['Payroll Line ID'] = salary_df['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str)
salary_df = salary_df[salary_df['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-')]
salary_df['norm_cost'] = salary_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary_df['norm_status'] = salary_df['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary_df = salary_df[salary_df['norm_status']=='paid']
salary_df['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(salary_df['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')
